description: This file defines the Progress struct and associated methods for tracking follower progress in the Raft consensus algorithm, including state transitions, message flow control, and progress updates.

classes.name: Progress
classes.description: Represents the progress of a follower node in the Raft consensus protocol, including log indices, state, inflights, and activity status.

methods.name: ResetState
methods.description: Resets the Progress to a specified state, clearing flow control flags and inflights.

methods.name: BecomeProbe
methods.description: Transitions the Progress into the Probe state, adjusting the Next index accordingly.

methods.name: BecomeReplicate
methods.description: Transitions the Progress into the Replicate state, resetting Next to Match+1.

methods.name: BecomeSnapshot
methods.description: Transitions the Progress into the Snapshot state with a specified snapshot index.

methods.name: SentEntries
methods.description: Updates progress after sending a number of log entries, adjusting Next and inflights.

methods.name: CanBumpCommit
methods.description: Checks if a given commit index can potentially advance the follower's commit index.

methods.name: MaybeUpdate
methods.description: Updates progress based on a MsgAppResp acknowledgment, returning false if outdated.

methods.name: MaybeDecrTo
methods.description: Adjusts progress upon receiving a rejection, potentially lowering Next.

methods.name: IsPaused
methods.description: Determines if sending log entries to the follower is currently throttled.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Progress object.
